svg.title: AI schema
svg.desc: AI activity (conversations, messages and attached files, the legacy content-view log, extension tokens, imports and topics) under the visibility and retention policy; the prompt library; private task chats; the usage ledger with model prices, the costed view, hourly rollups, budgets, running spend and alerts; the safety net and erasure requests; AI on people's own computers; report and workspace settings; and the company's AI connections, MCP client tables and tool-call audit, in the ai schema of the workspace database.
svg.text: AI CONNECTIONS · MCP CLIENT · TOOL-CALL AUDIT

NOTE ai_conversations.task_id, ai_task_chats.task_id and ai_local_sessions.task_id are work task ids; ai_prompt_library.conversation_id and mcp_pending.conversation_id (a Hỏi đáp or task chat) are by value; budgets are checked against ai_usage per person, department and workspace
NOT DRAWN outbox, processed_events, dead_events (standard shapes) · ai_hourly_stats is a rollup of prompts and ai_usage, read by the AI charts
